lead.description: the magnitude of a departure from a null value, kept separate from the probability of detecting it

overview_sentence: An effect size is the magnitude of a difference, kept apart from the probability of detecting it.

self_checks.title: Critical difference
self_checks.prompt: A standard error is 1.7 mmHg. What is 1.96 times that standard error?

self_checks.title: Shifted z-score
self_checks.prompt: The lower critical point is -3.332 and the true difference is -3, with standard error 1.7. What is the z-score?
self_checks.answer: The z-score is about -0.195, which rounds to -0.20.

self_checks.title: A larger effect
self_checks.prompt: The standard error is 2 mmHg and the true difference is -5. Using the critical value 1.96 times 2, what is the z-score of the lower critical point?
